question:

**Given series:** H, J, L, N, P, R, T,?

**Logic :** (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/084dfa702161d50ff7a486581229aeeb9aa455366c82775db21ea560ad7c77e5.png]
